review:
Christmas Big Bass Bonanza is the series' first festive spin-off, and it sticks closely to the original 2020 game. It plays on 5x3 reels with 10 paylines, and fish paying symbols carry random cash values that only matter during the bonus.

Three or more scatters trigger free spins. Every wild that lands during the round collects the values of all fish on screen and is also counted towards a retrigger. Every fourth wild collected adds 10 more spins and raises the collection multiplier to 2x, then 3x, and finally 10x on the third retrigger. That final level is where the largest results come from. The 96.71% RTP matches the original. If you have played Big Bass Bonanza, this is the same game with snow and Christmas music.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating

Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
